headline: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 5.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon)
text: Last night: Activity was enough (Hp30 max 5.3, 0.5 needed in Tromsø), but no aurora in the cameras' checks, several an hour (clouds or moon); magnetometer Kilpisjärvi -769 nT at 23:25; Tromsø clear 05–07, Alta clear 02–05
